_help: Game modes shown in the menu (Play). Edit, then run Sync-Modes.cmd (editor must be closed).
game: TDM | Domination   (TDM3 = three teams, not finished yet)
rules: Perspective = TP | FP | Choice (V / D-pad up switches), Loadout = comma list of Pistol, Rifle, Shotgun,
image: menu tile (1024x512 texture); empty = image of the template

modes.title: Team Deathmatch
modes.subtitle: Downtown
modes.description: Two city blocks. Streets, stoops, parked cars as cover. Switch between first and third person with V.

modes.title: Team Deathmatch (First Person)
modes.subtitle: Downtown
modes.description: Same streets, first person for everyone. No peeking around corners.

modes.title: Sidearms Only
modes.subtitle: Downtown
modes.description: Pistols only, first person, no weapon switching.

modes.title: Domination
modes.subtitle: Downtown
modes.description: Hold the north-west crossing, the middle block and the south-east crossing.

modes.title: Domination (First Person)
modes.subtitle: Downtown
modes.description: Hold the three street corners, first person for everyone.

modes.title: Team Deathmatch
modes.subtitle: Waterfront
modes.description: Office towers, a plaza and a fenced lot at the edge of the city. Long streets, switch perspective with V.

modes.title: Domination
modes.subtitle: Waterfront

modes.title: Team Deathmatch
modes.subtitle: Depot

modes.title: Domination
